hint_fr: Si c'était aux Noirs de jouer, ils perdraient : leur roi devrait lâcher e5, ou laisser passer le vôtre. L'ennui, c'est que c'est à vous. Avez-vous un coup qui ne change rien — sauf qui doit jouer ?
hint_en: If it were Black to move, Black would lose: the king would have to let go of e5, or let yours through. The trouble is, it's your move. Do you have a move that changes nothing — except whose turn it is?

claims.note: Syzygy tablebase (tablebase.lichess.ovh), checked 2026-10-08: a4 is the ONLY winning move, and all five king moves LOSE — a mutual zugzwang (trébuchet) decided by the spare tempo. a4 also takes away Black's own spare move ...a4.
